result.title: Composing Independently Distilled Memory and Retrieval Policies for Long-Term Agents
result.summary: Long-lived Web assistants require effective memory and retrieval mechanisms to access information from past user interactions. While these capabilities can be learned through specialized policies, it remains unclear whether specialists trained independently in different environments can be effectively composed without joint optimization. This paper investigates compositional transfer through policy distillation. Memory-writing and sequential retrieval policies are independently distilled from frontier-model action trajectories into 3B models and combined with a fixed answer generator without downstream training. On a LongMemEval-based benchmark, the distilled composition achieves 73.1% accuracy, compared with 36.2% for a composition of existing RL-trained specialists, and also outperforms the evaluated RL-trained compositions on PersonaMem-v2. Component ablations reveal that improvements in individual policies depend on their composition, highlighting the importance of cross-specialist compatibility. Further task-specific adaptation improves accuracy to 75.2% on LongMemEval through RL and 48.9% on PersonaMem-v2 through supervised distillation. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of independent specialist distillation for modular multi-agent systems. Source code and datasets of teacher-generated memory-editing and retrieval trajectories are released to facilitate reproducibility and further research.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将记忆写入与顺序检索策略分别从大模型动作轨迹独立蒸馏到 3B 模型，与固定答案生成器组合而不做联合优化，在 LongMemEval 与 PersonaMem-v2 上评测组合效果并做组件消融与任务特定适配。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「独立训练子策略 + 固定生成器」的模块化组合与顺序检索策略，可能为 LVR 中证据获取、何时继续检索或停止的独立策略训练及贡献分配提供可核查线索，但工作本身不涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理。
